notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Sources: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0000078003-26-000026, filed February 26, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0000078003-26-000033, filed March 12, 2026), read on EDGAR. LEADER: Bourla is a hired CEO (Chairman and Chief Executive Officer). He beneficially owns 378,551 shares of common stock as of January 31, 2026 (including shares credited under the Pfizer Savings Plan and deferred shares from vested awards), which the proxy says is less than 1% of shares outstanding, so pctEconomic is null. A further 1,072,649 stock units, some settled in cash after separation, are shown in a separate column and are not counted as shares; 5,984,997 TSRUs are also excluded. HOLDERS: the 2026 proxy repeats the 2025 proxy's 5% holders and figures, still based on Schedule 13G/A reports filed in early 2024 (Vanguard February 13, 2024; BlackRock January 26, 2024; State Street January 29, 2024); it gives only filing dates, so asOf is null, and the figures are about two years old. BUYBACKS: Pfizer bought back no stock in 2025; the cash-flow statement no longer has a share-purchase line, and the equity note says no shares were purchased under the program in any period presented. No ESPP or broad-based grant program was recorded.

footprint.notes: Pfizer's FY2025 10-K gives only company-wide facility counts (245 properties; Pfizer Global Supply responsible for 36 manufacturing plants, 'including in Belgium, Germany, India, Ireland, Italy, Japan, Singapore and the U.S.') and PP&E for the U.S. versus two international groups. Its glossary describes Developed Markets and Emerging Markets only non-exhaustively ('Includes, but is not limited to, the following markets: ...'), so no country list is attached to either region. No state or country breakdown of employees, investment or taxes was found: the 10-K gives only 'approximately 75,000 people worldwide', and the 2024 Impact Report Performance Data file had no headcount by geography (no newer Impact Report was checked for this edition). pfizer.com's U.S. Manufacturing Sites page (undated, re-read 2026-11-24 and unchanged) says 11 manufacturing sites and 2 distribution centers and 'More than 10,000 U.S. colleagues dedicated to manufacturing and supply operations', with no per-site headcount; ten of its sites are listed here; Sanford North NC is left out because the page describes it as not yet operational ('Once operational, the Sanford North facility will have the capabilities for producing biologics'). Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.

pay.notes: Employees: approximate year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or personnel costs, so the 2026 proxy's CEO pay ratio median for 2025 is used. The proxy breaks it down as cash compensation (including overtime) of $95,111, no equity, a $4,473 change in pension value and $47 of other compensation, and says the median-paid employee is the same one identified for the 2025 proxy.
